tokens.npc_dota_hero_monkey_king_bio:
For 500 years the mountain pressed down upon him, only his head free from the crushing weight of the stonewrought prison the elder gods had summoned to halt his childish rebellion. Moss grew along the lines of his exposed face, tufts of grass sprouted from his ears; his vision was framed in wildflowers reaching from the soil around his cheeks. Most thought him long dead, tormented by the gods for waging war against the heavens until naught but his legend survived. But, as the stories go, the Monkey King cannot die.

So he waited. Until the gods came to offer a chance at absolution, he endured. And when they did come to name the price, Sun Wukong accepted their charge: he would accompany a young acolyte on a secret pilgrimage, protect him from demons and dangers of the road, and guide the man home in possession of a coveted relic. Do that, and humbly obey the human's commands in service to their holy mission, and Wukong would prove himself reformed.

For a change, Sun Wukong fulfilled his oath to the gods with honor, and atoned for the sins of past insurrections. The acolyte, much learned in hardships, was returned to his home temple, relic in hand; and Wukong-finding himself for the first time in proper standing with any gods of consequence-was content for a short while to give up his old thirst for adventure and glory. But the Monkey King was born for mischief...and offending the gods never gets old.

Calling upon an army of monkey soldiers to overwhelm opponents, this agile trickster revels in the chaos of battle, ready to slam his legendary staff down on any hopes of escape.

** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** All ability effects are immediately applied to enemy units within the effect width and length, regardless of the ability animations.
** {{hi|Monkey King}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]]

**** Can affect enemy units up to {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Boundless Strike value1}}+{{#var:Boundless Strike value2}}}}-distance away with the effect width and length.

*# {{Symbol|fx|s}}
*#* The ability sound effects during its {{M|cast point}} is audible to everyone.
*# {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|monkey_king_boundless_strike_[[stun]]}}
*# {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*#* Procs any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal, except {{M|cleave}}.
*#* Have {{M|True Strike}}.
*#* Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
*#* Affects the following units:
*#** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*#* Does not affect the following units:
*#** {{M|Couriers}}
*#** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
*# Applies {{A|Monkey King|Jingu Mastery}} of its corresponding level to all hit enemy units, if the caster is a {{M|melee}} hero.

*#** The {{M|movement speed}} slow.

qualifications.raw:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Applies the {{M|required attacks}} counter {{M|debuff}} whenever Wukong does not have the {{Code|quadruple_tap}} {{M|buff}} active.

* {{Symbol|Tally}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Does nothing when attacking {{M|invulnerable}} units.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}}
*** Each successful attack on the enemy hero has the following properties:
**** Reapplies the debuff or increases the tally counter by 1 on the attacked enemy unit.
**** Refreshes the debuff duration, and update the ability values of the whole stack up to the required amount.
**** This includes both {{M|instant attack}} and {{M|secondary attack}} sources.
**** Considers attacks on {{M|clones}} as heroes; attacks on {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
** Once the tally counter reaches {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Jingu Mastery value1}}-1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Jingu Mastery value1 tal}}-1}}tal}}), the next successful attack grants Wukong the {{Code|quadruple_tap}} {{M|buff}}.
*** Grants flat {{M|unique bonus attack damage}}.
*** {{Symbol|Lifesteal}}
**** Stacks additively with other [[lifesteal]] sources.
**** Cannot lifesteal off the following units:
***** {{M|Ally units|x}}.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** An attack charge is consumed per successful attack.
*** Attacking {{M|items}} and {{M|runes}} does not consume charges.
*** Leveling up while the buff is active updates the ability values after one attack charge.
*** {{A|Monkey King|Boundless Strike}} cast spents 1 charge regardless of how many targets were hit.

* {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Wukong}}
** The Clones neither can utilize this ability, nor gain the {{M|buff}} from Wukong.
** {{cf|aghnotes}} This restriction is now removed upon acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}}.
*** The {{M|required attacks}} counter is now applied on the Clones, and works independently with Wukong's current counter.
*** Clones considers enemy {{M|clones}},{{M|illusions}} as heroes, {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||required attacks reduction|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4r}} does apply to the Clones' attacks.

fields.value:
Changes Monkey King's shape using the environment nearby to deceive opponents. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks the disguise.

Negates damage for a brief moment upon transforming.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Within Roshan's pit and while it is dead, Mischief disguises the Monkey King as [[Roshan]] himself.

The same applies to the [[Tormentor]].

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The trickster disguises himself as a Power Rune, with certain conditions of course.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Impersonates as a creep or any non-hero unit within the range.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Have you seen a tree move? Or a tree on top of another tree?

fields.name: desc6
fields.value: The higher Wukong's level, the lower the Mischief cooldown.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability is in the {{Spellslot|5|6}}.

* {{Symbol|a|Transform}}
** While transforming, Wukong {{M|cannot act}} and cannot be interrupted.
*** Interrupts the following actions upon cast:
**** Attack orders.
**** Move orders.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** Applies a {{M|damage negation}} buff upon cast, causing certain {{M|on-damage effects}} to not proc.
*** The following conditions {{M|dispel}} Mischief:
**** Wukong's attacks or ability cast, including item abilities.
**** Offensive damage instances {{Code|< {{#var:Mischief value2}}}} applied on Wukong ([[after reductions]]) after the damage negation duration.
*** Does not proc on the following damage sources:
**** Self-damage sources.
**** {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Wukong's [[minimap]] icon is now visible ally-only.
*** {{Symbol|Selection Box}}
**** Wukong's [[selection box]] adapts to the transformed models. However, it does not affect the following things:
***** {{M|Collision size}}.
***** Does not unperch Wukong from the {{A|Monkey King|Tree Dance}} {{M|tree}}.
*** {{Symbol|Health}}
**** The [[Health#HUD Health Bar|over-head]] health bar has the following properties:
***** {{Symbol|a|Transform}} {{to}} units
****** Copies the unit's current health bar, including its {{M|faction}} color.
***** {{Symbol|a|Transform}} {{to}} other options
****** Fully hides the health bar.
*** All [[Game Settings#Game|auto-attack]] settings and units ignore Wukong while in disguise, and Wukong can only be attacked by a {{cf|Hotkey|A}} forced attack order.
**** This neither affects {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted abilities nor {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} area-targeted abilities from applying its effects on Wukong.

* Asides from the priorities listed and when without any valid aformentioned entities within the search radius, Mischief randomly disguises Wukong into one of the following:
** {{I|Iron Branch}}
** {{I|Clarity}}
** {{I|Healing Salve}}
** {{I|Town Portal Scroll}}
** {{I|Tango}}
** Either a new or peeled [[File:Dota2 Monkey King Banana icon.png|21px]] Banana.

fields.name: miscnotes
fields.value:
{{Gamedesc
| image = {{#var:Mischief icon0}}
| desc = Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.
}}
* Disguising as {{M|Runes}} has the following priorities:
** Disguises into a {{M|Bounty Rune}} within its designated spot.
** At the river spots, Mischief disguises as a random [[Runes#Power|Power Rune]] regardless if there is a rune at that spot.
** Although the river spawns Bounty and Water Runes on the first spawns, Mischief still disguises Monkey King into a random Power-Up Rune.
** It does not matter whether there currently is a rune at the rune spot, Mischief disguises into a rune regardless.

* Disguising as non-hero unit has the following properties:
** If multiple units are within range, a random one is chosen.
** Can disguise as into any non-hero unit, except the following:
*** {{M|Roshan}} and the {{M|Tormentor}}
*** {{M|Creep-heroes}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* Disguising as a {{M|tree}} has the following properties:
** If multiple {{M|trees}} are within range, a random one tree model is chosen.
** Can disguise as a {{M|planted tree}} as well.
